topic: Peak Time Analysis - Call Routing Optimization

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Kevin, I know you're busy during peak hours, but we need to discuss our branch connectivity upgrade before our board meeting tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely, let me give you my full attention. Peak hours are busy, but your branch upgrade is priority. What's the timeline for the board decision?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: They meet at 9 AM tomorrow. I need cost estimates and implementation timeline for the three branch locations.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll have detailed proposals for all three branches in your inbox by 7 AM tomorrow. This gives you time to review before the board meeting.
